answer: Make every identity pay in computation. To stay eligible, an agent must each epoch solve a slow, memory-hungry puzzle seeded by its own public key and the latest public beacon, so no result can be precomputed or reused by another name. Think of a hollow shell: a nebula of fresh keys that skips the puzzle holds nothing and earns nothing. Each extra alias needs its own machine time and memory every epoch, so the farm's trellis of clones outgrows its budget.
